proof_dependencies.basis: Twisted exactness after clearing denominators at integer powers, an invertible exponent shift, and coefficientwise expansion with independent offset variables.
Dependence of differentiated forms in de Rham cohomology, a nonzero indicial polynomial, and a finite Čech resolution of the logarithmic complex.
Rational separation of a Minkowski sum plus a finitely generated cone, vertex feasibility, and the Laurent constant-term theorem of Duistermaat and van der Kallen.

sources.inspected: Theorems 1.6 and 1.10, resolution and normal-crossings principalization.
II Proposition 3.13 and Corollaries 3.14–3.15, the no-positive-integer-residue logarithmic comparison.
Sections 1 and 3, constant-term vanishing and Newton separation, including the boundary case.
Introduction, the Picard–Fuchs dependence of differentiated forms. The formal integer-root test is derived in the draft.
Section 1.3.1, twists and invertible translations. The specialization argument is derived in the draft.

arithmetic.method: Exact Python integer and SymPy rational-function calculations.
arithmetic.scope: Six shift certificates, 17,920 Laurent offset controls, 132 differential-equation controls, 7,920 weighted-support cases, 12 positive-ray moments and 900 coefficient slices for the worked example.
arithmetic.limits: The full constructive cohomology algorithm was not implemented.

blind_reader.reviewer: Fresh no-history internal AI reader with PDF-only follow-ups.
blind_reader.supplied_context: Only the compiled PDFs and paper-guide questions. Workspace, history and web sources excluded.

answers.contribution: The formal quadrant encoding and reduction to finitely many ordinary moments, with the Laurent common-weight and ray corollary.
answers.conceptual_reason: An invertible one-parameter shift tests the enlarged multiplier space, and an indicial polynomial bounds the first possible nonzero coefficient.
answers.hardest_step: Both directions of the finite test, the shared-denominator basis, and the finite logarithmic Cech comparison.
answers.limitations: Exact evaluation is assumed, complexity is unbounded by the present proof, and the positive-ray question remains for general traces.
answers.verification_obstacles: The draft now supplies compactification and coordinate-comparison details, explicit rational feasibility, a complete worked test and precise period and volume hypotheses. The final reader identified no remaining issue.
